parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, allowing users to view and interact with digital content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed but may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the screen upright and may allow limited tilt or rotation for ergonomic adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt slightly.
